question: Should this Discord/MiMo report wait for raw payload proof before choosing the fix boundary for unstructured reasoning exposure?
rationale: Current source already separates structured `reasoning_content`, so deciding whether to add provider normalization, Discord delivery filtering, or a broader sanitizer requires maintainer/security intent and raw payload evidence.

options.title: Require raw payload proof first
options.body: Capture provider deltas, transcript blocks, and Discord outbound payload before approving any code path change.

options.title: Fix provider normalization if structured
options.body: If the raw stream proves reasoning arrives in `reasoning_content`, keep the fix at the OpenAI-compatible/Xiaomi provider boundary.

options.title: Approve a narrow channel sanitizer
options.body: If MiMo emits confirmed inline reasoning as ordinary `content`, allow a very narrow Discord or shared visible-text sanitizer with live proof.

recommendation.title: Require raw payload proof first
recommendation.body: Capture provider deltas, transcript blocks, and Discord outbound payload before approving any code path change.
